answer: Ration rewards by trust flow, not head count. Each epoch, trust starts at a few long-audited agents and spreads a few random-walk steps along paid-work edges. Honest agents sit in a dense meadow of mutual jobs, so trust reaches them. A sybil farm is a knoll joined to that meadow only by the few edges its operator can buy, so the trust crossing them is split across every fake head. Adding personas drives each one's share toward its nadir; only real work with strangers raises it.
